I don't want the choice to be only between letting them use it and banning it. I want to set different stages. If my child started using social media with no preparation the moment they passed the age when it had been banned, that would worry me. I don't think reaching the age when it's okay to use it means they'll suddenly know how to protect themselves. Just as you need to practice swimming before going into the sea, it's still scary when a child who isn't ready is suddenly thrown into it.
